# Form Wizard

## Summary
Catalog (boxel-surface) multi-step form container: steps register
themselves via a DOM event contract and the wizard drives navigation.
Lives in the catalog realm at `boxel-surface/src/components/form-wizard`
(default export `FormWizard`).

## API
- `@activeStep` / `@defaultStep` — controlled or initial step id
- `@onStepChange(id)`, `@onFinish()` — navigation callbacks
- `@nextLabel`, `@previousLabel`, `@finishLabel` — button copy
- Blocks: default (the steps), footer
- Steps announce themselves with the `bx-form-step-register` event; the
  wizard exposes context under `boxel-surface:form-wizard`

## Usage
```gts
import FormWizard from 'https://realms-staging.stack.cards/catalog/boxel-surface/src/components/form-wizard';

<FormWizard @defaultStep='details' @onFinish={{this.submit}}>
  <FormStep @id='details'>…</FormStep>
  <FormStep @id='confirm'>…</FormStep>
</FormWizard>
```
